links.outcome: Test-retest reliability of LLM categorical recommendations across repeated runs
links.effect: Temporal stability was high (κ = 0.87-0.95); agreement with IMBD recommendations ranged from κ = 0.60 to 0.73.
links.quote: Agreement with IMBD recommendations ranged from κ = 0.60 to 0.73, with high temporal stability (κ = 0.87-0.95); pairwise differences between the three models were not statistically significant after Holm correction.

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLM performance on standardized retrospective medico-legal case vignettes without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
